name: Wrong Floor
detailed_description:
Survive the Descent – Or Be Consumed

Trapped in a plummeting elevator, you have no escape. Every floor opens to new horrors clawing their way in, and you’ll need to fight tooth and nail to survive. But the monsters aren’t your only problem—malfunctions, distractions, and mind-bending obstacles turn every second into a test of skill and focus.

Chaotic, Claustrophobic Horror

  • On-screen sabotage: Deal with Windows-style pop-ups, matching mini-games, pop balloons, and manage oxygen—all while fighting for your life.

  • Alarms and punishments: Ignore distractions too long, and you’ll trigger alarms or suffer major gameplay disadvantages.

  • Every second counts: The deeper you go, the more intense the fight becomes.

A Deadly Arsenal at Your Fingertips

Scavenge weapons as you descend—bottles, pistols, rifles, flamethrowers, and even sniper rifles can be found if you’re quick enough. Will you risk going for a better weapon or focus on surviving?

Unique Abilities – But Choose Wisely

Special abilities can turn the tide, but you can only carry one at a time.

  • Adrenaline Boost: Shoot faster and reload instantly.

  • Flamethrower Mode: Burn everything in your way.

  • Grenade Launcher: Deal massive area damage.

  • Bullet Time: Slow down time and land precise shots.
    Pick one, but choose carefully—grabbing another will overwrite your current ability!

  • and many more!

Speedrunning & Leaderboards

For those who crave a challenge, Wrong Floor features:

  • A built-in timer to track your best runs.

  • Global leaderboards to compete against other players.

  • Optimised gameplay that rewards fast reactions and smart choices.

short_description: Wrong Floor is a fast-paced, single-player horror shooter where you’re trapped in a malfunctioning elevator, fighting off waves of nightmarish creatures. As the elevator plummets, you'll have to manage your ammo, react quickly, and survive against increasingly intense floors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1050
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains occasional strong language used in dialogue. There are also stylized depictions of blood and violence during combat with enemies, which are presented in a non-realistic, cartoon-like manner. Some environmental models include pixelated nudity, which is abstract and not sexually explicit. The game does not include depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
